info.title: Qwen image editing
info.description: Ali Qwen image editing capability documentation. The unified API endpoint is `/v1/images/edits`. This document describes the public gateway contract for `qwen-image-2.0-pro` and `qwen-image-3.0-pro`: `input.messages[].content[]` carries images and text instructions, while other control fields use top-level OpenAI-style fields that the gateway maps to upstream `parameters`.

post.description:
Calls Ali `qwen-image-2.0-pro` or `qwen-image-3.0-pro` to perform single-image editing or multi-image fusion.

The public calling convention keeps top-level `model`, `input`, `response_format`, and exposes `n`, `size`, `watermark`, `prompt_extend`, `negative_prompt`, `seed` as top-level fields. Input images are placed in `input.messages[0].content[].image`, and the editing instruction is in a `text` item within the same array. The request body does not accept a top-level `parameters` field.

content.text: Replace the background with a seaside sunset
The girl in image 1 wearing the black dress from image 2, sitting in the pose from image 3

200.description: Success. Returns the image editing result.

401.description: Authentication failed, e.g. missing or invalid token.

429.description: Rate limit triggered or insufficient account quota.

500.description: Internal server error while processing the request.

502.description: Upstream provider returned an abnormal response.

503.description: Upstream provider is temporarily unavailable, or no available channel for the current model.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

response_format.description: Response format. `url` returns an image download link; `b64_json` returns Base64-encoded image data. Default is `url`.

n.description: Number of output images. Default is 1. For the `qwen-image-2.0` series, you can generate 1-6 images.

size.description: Output image resolution in `width*height` format, for example `1024*1536`. For the `qwen-image-2.0` series, total pixels must be between `512*512` and `2048*2048`. By default, total pixels are close to `1024*1024`, and the aspect ratio is close to the input image (for multi-image input, the last image). Recommended common resolutions: 1:1 `1024*1024`, `1536*1536`; 2:3 `768*1152`, `1024*1536`; 3:2 `1152*768`, `1536*1024`; 3:4 `960*1280`, `1080*1440`; 4:3 `1280*960`, `1440*1080`; 9:16 `720*1280`, `1080*1920`; 16:9 `1280*720`, `1920*1080`; 21:9 `1344*576`, `2048*872`.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark in the lower-right corner of the image. Default is `false`. For `qwen-image-2.0-pro`, the watermark is "Qwen-Image"; for `qwen-image-3.0-pro`, the watermark is "AI生成".

prompt_extend.description: Whether to enable smart prompt rewriting. Default is `true`. When enabled, the model optimizes the positive prompt (`text`), which is especially helpful for simple prompts.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used to describe content you do not want to see in the image and to constrain the image. Chinese and English are supported. Maximum length is 500 characters.

seed.description: Random seed. Range [0, 2147483647]. Using the same `seed` value can make generated content relatively stable. If omitted, the algorithm automatically uses a random seed. Note: generation is probabilistic, so the same `seed` cannot guarantee identical results every time.

messages.description: Request content array. Currently only single-turn conversations are supported, so the array must contain exactly one object with `role` and `content` properties.

role.description: Message sender role. Must be set to `user`.

content.description: Message content. Includes 1-3 images in `{"image":"..."}` format and a single edit instruction in `{"text":"..."}` format.

image.description: Input image URL or Base64 data. Supports 1-3 images. For multi-image input, images are ordered by array position, and the output image aspect ratio follows the last image. Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, WEBP, GIF (only first frame is processed). Recommended resolution: width and height between 384 and 3072 pixels. Image size: no more than 10 MB. Supports public HTTP/HTTPS URLs, OSS temporary URLs (`oss://...`), or Base64 data (`data:image/jpeg;base64,...`).

text.description: Edit instruction. Supports both Chinese and English. The `qwen-image-2.0` series supports up to 1300 tokens; extra content is automatically truncated. Note: only one `text` item is supported; omitting it or passing multiple text items causes an error.

n.description: Number of output images. Default is 1. For the `qwen-image-2.0` series, you can generate 1-6 images.

size.description: Output image resolution in `width*height` format, for example `1024*1536`. For the `qwen-image-2.0` series, total pixels must be between `512*512` and `2048*2048`. By default, total pixels are close to `1024*1024`, and the aspect ratio is close to the input image (for multi-image input, the last image). Recommended common resolutions: 1:1 `1024*1024`, `1536*1536`; 2:3 `768*1152`, `1024*1536`; 3:2 `1152*768`, `1536*1024`; 3:4 `960*1280`, `1080*1440`; 4:3 `1280*960`, `1440*1080`; 9:16 `720*1280`, `1080*1920`; 16:9 `1280*720`, `1920*1080`; 21:9 `1344*576`, `2048*872`.

watermark.description: Whether to add a "Qwen-Image" watermark in the lower-right corner of the image. Default is `false`.

prompt_extend.description: Whether to enable smart prompt rewriting. Default is `true`. When enabled, the model optimizes the positive prompt (`text`), which is especially helpful for simple prompts.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used to describe content you do not want to see in the image and to constrain the image. Chinese and English are supported. Maximum length is 500 characters.

seed.description: Random seed. Range [0, 2147483647]. Using the same `seed` value can make generated content relatively stable. If omitted, the algorithm automatically uses a random seed. Note: generation is probabilistic, so the same `seed` cannot guarantee identical results every time.

created.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

metadata.description: Additional result information. Field contents vary by capability.

url.description: Image download link. Valid for 24 hours.

type.description: Error type, e.g. `invalid_request_error`, `api_error`, or an upstream-compatible error type.
